`linesPerItem` is derived from the span mix of the *visible window*, but it is then applied to every item of the list, and it is multiplied by `avgHeight`, which is an average height per *item* — not per *line*. Suggestion: derive the height per *line* (group the visible items into lines, since they are ordered by index and a line ends when the accumulated span reaches `lanes`, taking the max height per line), or otherwise extrapolate from a window-independent quantity, instead of combining a span-weighted line count with a per-item average height.
